text: Worked example six point one. Take oxygen as minus two, potassium plus one, cyanide minus one, and carbon monoxide as neutral. Permanganate: plus seven. Dichromate: two chromiums share plus twelve, so plus six each. Ferrocyanide: the complex ion is minus four, so iron is plus two.
